comparison.objective: Thread and close a bent-foot U-lock around a bicycle wheel and stand; candidate uses a lifting pin to move and fixture a machined part, then retrieves the pin.
comparison.physical_skill: Angled two-ended crossbar engagement around obstacles versus axial bore insertion, spring-button actuation, load-bearing ball lock, suspended seating, and extraction.
comparison.success_condition: U-lock latched around both wheel and stand versus retained-pin pull test, supported lift, three-pad workpiece seating, unloaded pin withdrawal, and stable release.
comparison.reason: Both manipulate locking mechanisms, but the U-lock tests enclosure and crossbar closure rather than temporary load capture, weight transfer, and hardware recovery; no critical rubric detail is missing.
